task: Copyedit this fictional garden association's end-of-season letter only if an actual error needs attention. Its gentle formality and seasonal metaphor are deliberate. Keep the informative details, the thanks, and the existing length; do not modernise the voice or rearrange good prose merely to make a change.
input:
Dear neighbours,

The beds now rest, and our last workday before the winter closure is complete. The tools have been washed, the seed trays dried, and the shed put in order. Thank you to everyone who helped with that quiet work. The gate will remain closed until spring. We will post the reopening date when it has been agreed and send members the plan for next season.

With thanks,
The garden committee
